content.text:
The value of the Hash column identifies the hash protocol to be used with this HMAC credential when
this credential is referenced by an authority and used for authentication.  The value of this column is
ignored for host-invoked HMAC operations.
See [13] for details on matching key size to hash protocol selection.
5.3.2.27 Credential Table Group – C_HMAC_256 (Object Table)
